verdict.rationale: The evidence pack gives no published VRAM capacity for the RX 9070 XT, and no report of running a 70B-class quantized model on this card. The 'up to 48GB of VRAM' claim covers Radeon GPUs generally, not this card, and support for llama.cpp and vLLM concerns software compatibility rather than memory capacity. The only figure specific to this card is a community-reported 640 GB/s of GDDR6 bandwidth, which alone does not show that 70B inference fits or is practical.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run a 70B-class quantized LLM on this GPU — published VRAM capacity and memory bandwidth that make local or single-node inference practical
